text:
Maya Chen: Morning folks — quick holiday check-in! What's your go-to winter commute playlist AND your favorite quick warm desk food? Bonus points for microwave chili recipes under 5 minutes. Also, shoutouts for the office gift drop-off volunteers today! :snowflake:

Alex R: Ooh playlist = 'Late Night Drive' mix. Heated socks recommendation from me. :socks:

Jamie: Microwave chili (2-min hack):
```
1 can beans
1 can diced tomatoes
2 tbsp chili powder
1/2 cup shredded cheese
Microwave 90s, stir, 30s more, top with cheese
```
Seriously warms the soul and desk.

Samir: Commute tip — keep a change of shoes at the office + plastic bag for wet boots. Saved me last week. :thumbsup:

Priya K: Huge shoutout to Nina for coordinating the gift drop-off and table setup. It looks great! :tada: @Nina

Nina: Thanks!! If anyone's dropping stuff after 3pm, please leave it in the labeled bin by the kitchen. Tag me if you need pickup help.

Mike C: My playlist (if anyone wants): https://open.spotify.example/playlist/abcd1234 — mostly mellow tracks for icy sidewalks.

TransitBot: ⚠️ Green Line experiencing 7–10 min delays due to signal checks. Plan accordingly.

Alex R: Also, who wants to split a thermos of chili tomorrow? 5 votes and I'll bring extra spoons. :bowl_with_spoon:

Maya Chen: Count me in. And thanks for the volunteers again — gonna drop a small treat for the table after the standup. :heart:

Samir: Emoji check-in: :snowman: :coffee: :socks:

Priya K: Love it. Happy almost-holidays everyone! Keep each other warm out there. :sparkles:
